scope: Synthetic codec fixtures only; no real caller, host attestation, TPM, phone or production issuance.

fieldDescriptions.hex: Exact capture CBOR bytes, expected inner and selected schema 4 unless a test deliberately chooses another contract.
fieldDescriptions.execEpoch: Unsigned UInt64 in decimal STRING form to avoid JSON signed/floating-point loss.
fieldDescriptions.arguments/environmentNames/*Path/process: Lowercase hex of original raw bytes; no normalization.
fieldDescriptions.credentialUIDs/credentialGIDs: Four UInt32 roles in real/effective/saved/filesystem order. UID need not equal GID.
fieldDescriptions.sessionID: Positive Int32-bounded UInt32 or explicit null.
fieldDescriptions.streamKinds/streamAccess/streamFlags: Three integer wire tags/masks in stdin/stdout/stderr order.
fieldDescriptions.captureSHA256: SHA256 of exact capture bytes, equal to issued request captureDigest.
fieldDescriptions.invalid.limits: Override defaultLimits for this refusal control; budget cases contain otherwise valid base bytes.
fieldDescriptions.digestMutations: Each row references base by name; hash exact raw bytes even when validCapture=false. Invalid mutations of fixed profile/credential roles/terminal/mask are never accepted captures.
